description: Builds an unsigned ERC-20 approve() and returns an approval URL. Typically used before a swap when the router doesn't have allowance yet.

amount.description: Amount in token units. Pass "max" via a very large amount string for unlimited approval.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

spender.description: Contract authorized to spend tokens (e.g. Uniswap router).

name: approve_erc20
title: Approve an ERC-20 spender
